summary: Frontend-only retest of /bi round-2 changes (filter bar + bigger/interactive card visualizations) with superadmin@sipro.co.id. All 6 requested items PASS: filter bar (bi-period, filter-trigger-project, filter-trigger-tanggal) renders; project filter checkbox -> chip + bi-project-hint + API called with project_id on Eksekutif/Penjualan/Proyek while Marketing (/analytics/marketing/performance) and Tim (/analytics/users/daily) load without project_id; custom daterange sends date_from/date_to and header shows 'Rentang 2026-06-01 → 2026-08-29'; chip-clear/Reset filter restore period range (2026-07-31 → 2026-08-29); partial date shows amber 'Isi juga Sampai tanggal' hint and does NOT fire an API call; desktop card grid computed as 3 columns (416px each); SLS-01 sparkline tooltip works on hover ('2026-07 3'); '% tercapai' label on SLS-02/BGT-04; MKT-02 shows '+1 kategori lain di Rincian'; MKT-03 ROAS shows 'belum ada data' with no spark. Regression: all 5 hub tabs + Kamus Metrik (53 dictionary rows) load, MetricDetailDialog opens (3 rows) & closes on Esc, 15 drill links, 'Segarkan' refetches, period select ('Seluruh data' -> period=all) works. 0 console errors across all runs.

issues: DashboardShell grid uses sm:grid-cols-2, so at 768px content width the cards become only ~216px wide: metric titles truncate ('UNIT TERJUAL ...', 'KAS MAS...') and large currency values overflow the card edge (e.g. 'Rp 3.800.000.000' clipped in SLS-03). Suggest md:grid-cols-2 (or container queries) and/or compact formatting for the hero value on narrow cards.
Uses native browser <input type=date> pickers (mm/dd/yyyy, locale-dependent) instead of the shadcn calendar used elsewhere. Pre-existing FilterBar pattern, low priority but inconsistent.

action_items: Optional: change DashboardShell card grid breakpoint from sm:grid-cols-2 to md:grid-cols-2 (or use container query) to avoid truncated titles/overflowing currency values at ~768px viewport with sidebar open.

Optional: each dashboard tab fires the analytics request twice on mount (duplicate identical GET observed for executive/marketing/users-daily/sales-funnel/schedule-health/metrics). Likely React StrictMode double-invoke in dev; verify it does not double-fetch in production build.
critical_code_review_comments: BiPage baseParams correctly gates custom range on BOTH dates being present, so the partial-date state never issues a request — good.
MetricSpark Sparkline uses cumulative series with padded YAxis domain; tooltip payload reads row.bucket/row.v consistently — no defects found.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BI filter bar + card viz round-2 fully verified (iteration_106). Tab testids follow 'tab-page-tab-<key>' (not 'bi-hub-tab-<key>'). Only 1 project in seed ('Cluster Asri Blok A'). Remaining known cosmetic issue: card grid too narrow at 768px causing truncation.
rca_of_the_issue: Tablet truncation root cause: `grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3` in /app/frontend/src/components/bi/DashboardShell.js line 124 switches to 2 columns at 640px viewport, but the fixed sidebar (~256px) leaves ~480px of content, giving 216px cards that cannot fit the hero currency values.
